newsitem.title: GERMANY: Meeting of G7 officials in Frankfurt over-source.
newsitem.headline: Meeting of G7 officials in Frankfurt over-source.

text.p: A meeting of deputy finance ministers for the Group of Seven nations held in Frankfurt on Monday has ended, a U.S. government official said.
The official was unable to comment on the contents of the meeting, called to prepare an agenda for this weekend's G7 meeting in Berlin.

However, a German government source said the talks had been expected to concentrate on the world economic position, international development aid, currency rate developments and increased cooperation between supervisory authorities.
The meeting was attended by deputy finance ministers from Britain, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan and the United States.

Sources said earlier that the U.S. deputy Treasury secretary Lawrence Summers and German state secretary to the Finance Ministry Juergen Stark were attending the meeting, which was held at the Bundesbank in Frankfurt.
The Bundesbank would not comment on the meeting.
